calvino_source.inner_arch: Two irreconcilable ways of speaking of Dorothea: a closed deterministic demographic and commodity-combinatoric calculus from which past, present, and future are wholly deducible versus the lived existential rupture of arriving in first youth on a wind-whipped morning that shatters single-track desert fate into a sheaf of open futures.

anti_trude_vector.medium: Split/hinged brass astrolabe-ledger vs. kinetic wind-banner bazaar canvas + Royal Plate Guild cartographic map (map.png/map.svg) & fine-art city plate (image.png)
anti_trude_vector.mechanism: One face operates as a cold brushed-aluminum and canal-green 9-quarter fortified ledger with 7 spring drawbridges and exogamous bergamot/roe/astrolabe/amethyst deduction across past, present, and future; piercing, rotating, or unlatching the brass astrolabe (itself one of the four traded monopolies) cracks the deterministic matrix along a physical alidade hinge into windswept polychrome cloth banners, 3-soldier WebAudio brass trumpet harmonics, spinning wheels, direct eye-contact pulses, and branching caravan trajectories, complemented by an inspectable Map & City Plate drawer referencing map.png and image.png.
anti_trude_vector.dom_signature_strategy: Custom semantic/bespoke tags (<dorothea-instrument>, <astrolabe-hinge>, <alidade-reticle>, <fortified-ledger>, <canal-lattice>, <quarter-cell>, <drawbridge-spring>, <monopoly-reckoner>, <bazaar-rupture>, <trumpet-platform>, <banner-rigging>, <horizon-sheaf>, <archival-plate-drawer>, <cartographic-plate>, <limner-plate>) and doro-* CSS selectors with zero generic card/modal/dashboard chrome to guarantee J_dom < 0.35.

epistemic_partition.principle: Dorothea's two descriptions are ontologically irreconcilable. The combinatoric builder and the camel-youth builder operate under strict mutual blindness.
rules: dorothea-actuary is forbidden from reading charter.json or layers/morning_banners.js and models ONLY the combinatoric architecture and monopoly calculus.

dorothea-banner-youth is forbidden from reading charter.json or layers/combinatoric_quarters.js and models ONLY the camel driver's morning arrival, bazaar kinetics, brass trumpets, direct gazes, and branching desert routes.
Royal Plate Guilds supply museum-grade map.png + map.svg (1600x1200) and image.png (1600x1000) directly into cities/03_dorothea/.

dorothea-weaver fuses layers/combinatoric_quarters.js and layers/morning_banners.js as soon as both layers are ready (without waiting for map.png/image.png on disk), integrating an inspectable Map & City Plate drawer referencing src="map.png" and src="image.png" inside standalone index.html.
dorothea-critic conducts title-masked blind recognition and verifies HG-1..HG-3 plus Royal Plate files before final PASS.

hard_gates.HG-1: 100% standalone zero-dependency index.html (all JS/CSS inlined, zero http/https URLs, zero ../ cross-city imports, zero JS syntax/runtime errors), clean responsive layout at 1280x800 desktop and 390x844 mobile, full keyboard accessibility, prefers-reduced-motion compliance, gesture-gated mute-capable WebAudio, plus valid Royal Plate map.svg, map.png (1600x1200), and image.png (1600x1000).
hard_gates.HG-2: Anti-Trude morphological uniqueness (J_dom < 0.35 via bespoke custom element tag-paths and doro-* selectors, zero generic template cards), authentic split/hinged brass astrolabe mechanism bridging the two irreconcilable accounts, and inspectable Archival Map & City Plate drawer inside index.html referencing src="map.png" and src="image.png".
hard_gates.HG-3: Title-masked blind recognition succeeds and every canonical Calvino stone in both accounts participates causally in the deterministic-calculus vs. existential-rupture inner arch.
